quests.title: The Search for an Exit
quests.summary: Awakened in an unfamiliar room with an identity document bearing your name, explore the shifting corridors and find a way out of the repeating loop.

explore_loop.description: Follow the cycling doors past the projector and discover the nature of the entity blocking the corridor.

objectives.text: Examine your identity document in the waking room.
Overcome the toxic emanation in the corridor by taking pain elixir.

reach_antechamber.description: Follow the long carpeted hallway past the ember cloud into the central two-door antechamber.

objectives.text: Pass through the revealed door and locate the two-door room.

completed.description: You have breached the initial loop and entered the deeper antechamber.

objectives.text: Initial loop breached.

quests.title: The Crimson Countdown
quests.summary: Roman numerals freshly painted in blood on the antechamber wall are descending from IX toward zero as you explore each quadrant of the space.

tally_numerals.description: Explore the dark kitchen, the wood-paneled maze, and the visceral room to advance the count.

objectives.text: Observe numeral IX after navigating the kitchen and dining hall.
Observe numeral VIII after escaping the paneled labyrinth.
Observe numeral VII after investigating the visceral room.
Reach the green armchair room as the countdown strikes zero.

completed.description: The countdown has reached its conclusion. The final door to judgment stands unlocked.

objectives.text: Countdown concluded.

quests.title: The Shroud without a Body
quests.summary: Track and neutralize the levitating coarse rag that projects nausea, blurred vision, and temporal distortion across the corridors.

hunt_rag.description: Confront the hovering rag entity in the corridor and kitchen.

objectives.text: Strike down the rag in the initial dark corridor.
Recover a sample of the floating entity cloth.

completed.description: The shroud has been proven to be empty fabric, robbed of its toxic grip on your mind.

objectives.text: Rag entity neutralized.

quests.title: The Fire-Ember Melody
quests.summary: Investigate the swirling cloud of dust and embers at the dead end of the carpeted hallway and silence its ceaseless chime.

silence_melody.description: Approach the music box at the end of the long hallway and examine its mechanism.

objectives.text: Disperse the ember cloud in the long hallway.
Retrieve the rattling music box from the alcove.

completed.description: The music box rests in your pack, silent and motionless at last.

objectives.text: Music box secured.

quests.title: Records of the Clinic
quests.summary: Recover patient case files, intake vouchers, and diagnostic records from the archive cabinets to piece together your institutional past.

gather_records.description: Search the filing room and speak with the Archivist to assemble the case files.

objectives.text: Retrieve Case File #001 from the filing cabinets.
Locate a signed Self-Admission Contract.

completed.description: The institutional records confirm your methodology. The clinic was your domain of absolute control.

objectives.text: Clinical archive inspected.

quests.title: A Complaint Concerning Transit
quests.summary: Deal with the distraught father in the clinic lobby who is desperately seeking to register a complaint regarding his missed transportation.

resolve_father.description: Decide whether to deceive the father into involuntary commitment or reveal the grim truth of his situation.

objectives.text: Confront the distressed father in the clinic lobby.

completed.description: The father's encounter is concluded, leaving an indelible mark upon your alignment.

objectives.text: The father's fate decided.

quests.title: Bella and Braxton
quests.summary: Revisit the childhood memory of the upstairs tiled bathroom and the message left in the porcelain tub.

inspect_tub.description: Locate the clawfoot tub and recover the father's shaving blade from the mirrored cabinet.

objectives.text: Examine the stains in the porcelain clawfoot bathtub.
Retrieve the father's shaving blade from the cabinet.

completed.description: The memory is intact. A point had to be made so your parents would listen.

objectives.text: Childhood message recalled.

quests.title: The Final Accounting
quests.summary: Face the ultimate manifestation in the Hall of the Final Verdict and claim the key to the waking room door.

face_verdict.description: Enter the amphitheater, take your place upon the green fabric armchair, and defeat the collective judgment.

objectives.text: Sit upon the green armchair in the Judgment Hall.
Defeat the physical manifestation of the Verdict.

completed.description: The Verdict has been dismantled. The final door stands open back to where you first awoke.

objectives.text: Judgment completed.
